name: Restoran 010 — menü veya masa kabuğu açılır
description: Demo Restoran (010) seçildikten sonra Restoran kabuğu menü/masa görünümü ile açılır.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Restoran (CODE 010), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the Restaurant / Restoran module from the top shell tabs
Verify the restaurant shell is active showing floor/tables, menu, or restaurant dashboard content labeled for restaurant operations, not stuck on Market POS only
